scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide city street with tall buildings on both sides,
scene_analysis.buildings: The buildings have a mix of old and new architecture, with some featuring ornate facades and others having more modern designs.
scene_analysis.materials: The street is paved with asphalt and has a few cracks and potholes.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and trash cans along the sidewalk.
scene_analysis.vegetation: The street is lined with trees and flowers, adding a touch of greenery to the urban landscape.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs advertising local businesses and services.
scene_analysis.pedestrian_activity: People are walking along the sidewalk, some stopping to chat or take photos.
scene_analysis.as_resident: The area appears to be quiet and peaceful, with only a few people out and about.
scene_analysis.as_tourist: The street is lined with historic landmarks and points of interest.
scene_analysis.as_student: The street is also home to a number of restaurants and cafes, offering a range of food and drink options.
